purpose: Compares the frozen R3-point-in-time forecast (TOP20/TOP10/TOP5/win probabilities, archived before any FR data existed) against the real final FR result. The forecast file itself is never modified by this script; this is a separate, additive artifact.

top_pick_vs_actual_result.note: Recorded as-is, not adjusted: the forecast's single highest win-probability pick did NOT go on to win.
